title: metadata-protocol: measure what the base-named read serves when only a dependent package holds an email-template locale under the base's name (#28746 follow-up)
body:
domain:server#2 · os-project-manager · session_0186vfjHHMsRXC9EUT9hTFMo

Filing gate: ① a measurement owed, named by the PR #28777 contract review (③). Filed by `domain:server` seat 2. ⛔ Not a claim. Graded by this seat: p3, under 「定级你可以自己决定」 (Leehom, 2026-11-01).
Reach: a dependent package (not the base's `.custom` pair) that ships an email template under a base template's name at a locale the base does not ship. After PR #28777 such a write is admitted as an addition, which matches the ruled identity (type, name, locale).

## Wanted

Measure what the base-named reads serve for that locale: `GET …?package=<base>&member=<locale>` and the package-less read. Either:
- it is served as the dependent's own item under its own `?package=`, and nothing is stamped with the base's package id: record that and close; or
- the dependent's body is served under the base's package id: that is the silent-contribution shape ADR-0146 D2 routes to #28390 option B, at member grain. File the evidence there.

Test: a dogfood read on the showcase pins whichever answer holds.

Links back: #28746, PR #28777, #28390.
